objective: First bounded managed-to-native control action in an owned D3D11 workload
decisions: Keep copy-elision-lab immutable and add manager-lab as a separate path
Allow one epoch, one action bit, one action budget, and short expiry
Keep policy classification and action on the native path
Pin the hook module and retain forwarding state until process exit
Make stale entrypoints observation-neutral after detach
Reject reattach because ABI v1 has no attachment generation
Block performance claims unsupported by paired evidence
limitations: no RAM or VRAM residency backend
no external attach or game support
